title: Filipino-Style Pancit Canton
description: A classic Filipino dish made with stir-fried noodles, vegetables, and your choice of protein. This recipe serves 4-6 people and can be customized to suit your taste.

ingredients.name: Pancit Canton
ingredients.notes: found in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Ground pork
ingredients.notes: optional, can use chicken or tofu instead

instructions: Cook Pancit Canton according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic and stir-fry until onion is translucent.
Add snow peas and carrots and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add ground pork (if using) and stir-fry until cooked through.
Add cooked Pancit Canton and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Season with soy sauce, salt, and pepper to taste.
